Launch each generated normal libtest executable directly with exactly --ignored --exact allocation_receiving --nocapture --test-threads=1 from a fresh harness-owned evidence working directory. Cargo test itself changes CWD to the package root; direct execution keeps large wire files outside source.

The fixed test accepts no fixture switches, alternate cardinalities, paths, byte budgets, or fixture replacement inputs. Its explicit ignore attribute keeps 200000-request operator work and large wire outputs out of default workspace test execution. The checked role owns the exact libtest filter and single test thread. World helper harness requires Linux /proc.

Both integration test executables emit a successful8192-byte/one-call allocator control. The global allocator is specific to these targets; allocation capture activation and byte/call counters are thread-local to the selected test. No package-global fixture switch is mutated.

Each synchronous measured closure counts successful System alloc/alloc_zeroed/realloc requested sizes and calls on the selected libtest thread, excluding unrelated libtest threads. Every successful realloc counts its full requested new size, including in-place realloc; failed requests do not count. None of the measured owner operations dispatches work to another thread. Process-wide requested-live bytes count all successful allocations and deallocations; their scoped peak and /proc RSS remain whole-process metrics. Each observation explicitly declares these two distinct scopes.

These are native requested-byte/allocation-call metrics, not Go TotalAlloc/HeapAlloc, libc usable size, RSS, or GC metrics. Requested-byte totals and allocation calls are selected-thread metrics; requested-live and /proc RSS/peak are explicitly whole-process. The independent reader refuses scope substitutions.

Logging, workload preparation where prescribed by the original ceiling, artifact writes and digests run outside measured closures. World model construction is itself measured; cumulative totals sum the declared measured stages.

Closed create_new artifact filenames are {binary-world|compressed-world}-{20000|200000}.{expanded|restored|compressed}.wire relative to harness CWD. Never overwrite/delete existing outputs; retained rows carry paths and actual SHA256. RawWorld has no compressed artifact.

Read each raw log with driver/allocation_receiving.py --target gomad|wasmhost LOG. The reader enforces the complete target-specific row inventory, numeric types, self-control, workload sizes, exact original bounds, byte digests, cumulative arithmetic and terminal cardinalities.
